text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant reports progress in talks on customs and excise duties to replace Value Added Tax.
- Opposition says VAT law should be amended rather than replaced and insists that government proposals on alternative system will increase inflation.

- Dutch Foreign Minister, Hans van Mierlo, chairman of the EU Council of Ministers, holds talks in Malta on Euro-Med conference. Mierlo said he was hopeful of good results from the meeting of foreign ministers of EU and southern Mediterranean states due to be held on April 15 and 16.
